basic_info.description: Spacious, Tunnel-Entry style home in desirable Outer Sunset. Inviting, light-filled living room with fireplace is perfect for lounging, family time, and entertaining. A true formal dining room opens up to the kitchen, contributing to the comfortable, functional floorplan. All three bedrooms are on the main level. There are hardwood floors throughout. The garage and full basement has ample space for parking 2 cars and full height ceilings; offering potential for expansion. Enjoy outdoor time and a BBQ in your lovely, flat back yard. Great opportunity to own a home in a coveted location for an affordable price.
